listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Animals – Dogs, Cats, Lions, Elephants & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: the perfect first animal coloring book!

Little artists meet 30 friendly animals, from the farm and the zoo to the garden and the sea. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines and feel proud of every page.

Inside you'll find:

  • 30 cute animals: dog, cat, cow, pig, sheep, horse, chicken, duck, rabbit, mouse, bear, lion, elephant, giraffe, monkey, panda, fox, hedgehog, owl, penguin, frog, turtle, fish, whale, octopus, crab, snail, bee, butterfly and ladybug
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, made for crayons and chunky markers
  • The animal's name in big letters on every page, to color and to learn first words
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5, and a sweet gift for birthdays, holidays and travel.

Part of the my first step series. Also try My First Trucks Coloring Book.
